en_title: CD Projekt Red Used AI to Alter Geralt's Voice Due to Polish Actor's Health Issues
cn_title: 因波兰配音演员健康问题，CDPR使用AI修改杰洛特的声音
opus_summary: 《巫师3》新资料片《旧时曲》中，CDPR将使用AI工具调整杰洛特波兰语配音演员Jacek Rozenek的声音，使其与2014年的配音相符。Rozenek曾因中风导致声音变化，并已同意使用该工具。CDPR称，未经配音演员明确许可，不会使用AI工具改变其声音。

paragraphs.en: The Witcher 3 is getting a new expansion more than 11 years after it first released, and due to a health issue experienced by Geralt's Polish voice actor, CD Projekt Red will be using an AI tool to modify his voice.
paragraphs.cn: 《巫师3》首次发售11年多后即将推出一款新资料片。由于杰洛特的波兰语配音演员遭遇健康问题，CDPR将使用AI工具修改他的声音。

paragraphs.en: Jacek Rozenek, who voiced Geralt in The Witcher 3's Polish dub, will be returning to voice Geralt in Songs of the Past . Rozenek notably suffered a stroke back in 2019 that affected his voice. Thanks to modern technology, CD Projekt Red is able to use an AI voice modulator, Respeecher, to alter the actor's voice to match his 2014 lines, as noted by Game File .
paragraphs.cn: 在《巫师3》波兰语配音版中为杰洛特配音的Jacek Rozenek将回归，在《旧时曲》中继续为杰洛特配音。Rozenek曾在2019年中风，声音因此受到影响。据Game File报道，借助现代技术，CDPR能够使用AI声音调制工具Respeecher修改这位演员的声音，使其与他2014年的台词一致。

paragraphs.en: According to the post, Rozenek's stroke left him unable to even speak for a while, and he only gained his voice back after a ton of rigorous training. He was able to return for a couple of quests in the Next-Gen update that came out back in 2022, but told Game File that he "was so exhausted after this recording." Still, CD Projekt Red wanted him to return for the new expansion, so it had to think outside the box.
paragraphs.cn: 据该报道，Rozenek中风后一度甚至无法说话，经过大量严格训练才恢复了说话能力。他得以回归，为2022年推出的次世代更新中的几个任务配音，但他告诉Game File，自己「在这次录音后筋疲力尽」。尽管如此，CDPR仍希望他回归参与新资料片的制作，因此必须另辟蹊径。

paragraphs.en: The main problem was that, after everything Rozenek went through, his voice was noticably different than it was in 2014 when he recorded the bulk of Geralt's lines for the original game. Rozenek's voice is now much lower pitched than it used to be, which would make any new lines sound odd when played next to the older ones that are supposed to take place in the same time period. Hence, the need for Respeecher.
paragraphs.cn: 主要问题是，在经历了这一切之后，Rozenek的声音与他2014年为原版游戏录制杰洛特大部分台词时明显不同。Rozenek现在的声音比以前低沉得多，如果将新台词与那些设定在同一时期的旧台词放在一起播放，就会显得很奇怪。因此，他们需要Respeecher。

paragraphs.en: Respeecher's model was trained on all of Rozenek's lines from the original game, but it sounds like this was doing a lot more than just running his voice through a quick filter. When asked about the process, Respeecher synthetic speech artist Dmytro Vasylets told Game File that "getting there took dozens of hours, training models, going through the details with the CDPR team, and dealing with AI artifacts that never fully disappear."
paragraphs.cn: Respeecher的模型使用Rozenek在原版游戏中的全部台词进行训练，但听起来，这一过程远不只是简单地给他的声音加上滤镜。被问及这一过程时，Respeecher合成语音艺术家Dmytro Vasylets告诉Game File：「要达到这个效果，我们花了几十个小时训练模型、与CDPR团队逐一讨论细节，并处理那些永远无法完全消除的AI伪影。」

paragraphs.en: CDPR got Rozenek's blessing to use the tool, who told Game File, "I have great trust… for the creators of this game," and that, "when it comes to the dynamics of the voice, when it comes to the acting aspects, I feel very good, really very good."
paragraphs.cn: CDPR使用该工具得到了Rozenek的同意。他告诉Game File：「我非常信任……这款游戏的创作者。」他还表示：「说到声音的动态变化，说到表演方面，我感觉非常好，真的非常好。」

paragraphs.en: Still, CDPR is aware of the optics of using AI anywhere near a voice actor, and it stressed to Game File that this was a special case. CD Projekt Red localization producer Mikołaj Szwed told the publication that the company wouldn't be using any AI tools to alter someone's voice without the express permission of that voice actor.
paragraphs.cn: 尽管如此，CDPR清楚在配音演员相关工作中使用AI会给外界留下怎样的印象，并向Game File强调这是一个特例。CDPR本地化制作人Mikołaj Szwed告诉该媒体，未经配音演员明确许可，公司不会使用任何AI工具修改其声音。

paragraphs.en: Even for The Witcher 4 , which Rozenek is expected to return for, the tool won't be needed, due to Geralt being older and more grizzled, so a deeper voice won't be so jarring.
paragraphs.cn: 即便是在Rozenek预计会回归参与的《巫师4》中，也不需要这个工具，因为杰洛特年纪更大、更显沧桑，低沉一些的声音不会那么突兀。

paragraphs.en: But while this seems like a good use of AI, the technology is still extremely controversial in gaming. Last year, the Indie Game Awards stripped the Game of the Year award from Clair Obscur: Expedition 33 after AI-generated placeholder textures were found in the game . Players have also found AI-generated art in Crimson Desert, though it's since been patched out.
paragraphs.cn: 但尽管这似乎是AI的一种良好用途，这项技术在游戏领域仍然极具争议。去年，在《光与影：33号远征队》中发现AI生成的占位贴图后，Indie Game Awards撤销了该作获得的年度游戏奖。玩家也曾在《红色沙漠》中发现AI生成的美术内容，不过这些内容后来已通过补丁移除。
